qualification: Local source application only. Two routes: standalone CQC shell and direct versus module. Real UI handlers drive selections, costumes, match settings, stage selection and pause. Read-only diagnostics and a transparent offscreen draw measure native preview geometry. Public replay API intentionally tests an old invalid costume fixture; no engine/state manipulation or synthetic simulation stepping. Headless fullscreen API is outside this check.

checks.name: 1 Bootstrap native body catalog and zero dormant RAW requests
2 Source mappings retained; 358 other incarnations hidden and 4 same-period costumes available
3 Old invalid preferences resolve to original; legitimate late-registered preference restored, store untouched
4 Meryl MGS1 retains her own human/cyborg/formal/native MSX outfits; no MGS4 or remake costume
5 Actual native preview has a common stature and foot baseline across same-sized Meryl costumes
6 Attested Pliskin and Tatyana disguises use the same-period selectors and native previews
7 Repeated normal costume changes and large viewport resize keep native images visible
8 Real UI and stage confirmation start a ready native retro match

limits: New native low-resolution sprite drawings in a MSX2-inspired style. No image downsampling, pixel-removal filter, procedural pixelArt shader or reuse of an original actor PNG is involved.

This style reinterpretation is original art, not a costume shipped by the publisher and not a 1:1 extraction of an original MSX game sprite. The character stays in the exact original listed incarnation.

Square pixel clusters and reduced material shading are visible in the actual drawings. Generator output retains antialias fringe and more than sixteen native RGB colors; actual MSX palette/hardware restrictions are not certified.
Sixteen physical poses per anatomical facing, all inspected. Native two-facing PNG bytes are immutable. Read-only alpha16 vector contours exclude neighboring figures without editing source pixels.

Limited combat keys share sixteen authored body poses; grenade, grappling and exceptional move equipment keyframes are not all separately drawn. Engine move timing, damage, projectiles, identity and scale are unchanged.

Source standing height is measured from the two native idle figures per direction and kept fixed across poses. Feet/pelvis pivots are measured per figure; this is not original animation motion capture.
Right cell10 contains an authored muzzle flash and is retained physically but deliberately unused in runtime; its shooting action repeats the clean aim cell9 to avoid doubling gameplay VFX.
Original designed costume, not an attested released Snake cyborg appearance.
Independent 2.5D redraw inherits authored gameplay pose adaptation; no motion-capture or exact original-game animation claim.
Small highlights, armour seam/cable placement and occluded parts vary between independently rendered poses.
Body source fitting and physical weapon-source geometry require the separately recorded actual Canvas proof.
